2.152.5
ChartLegend.ChartLegendTitle
Applies to RDL 2008/01, RDL 2010/01, and RDL 2016/01
The ChartLegend.ChartLegendTitle element specifies the title of a ChartLegend. This element is
optional. This element is of type ChartLegendTitle.
Following is the parent element of the ChartLegend.ChartLegendTitle element.
Parent elements
ChartLegend
The following is the XML Schema definition of the ChartLegend.ChartLegendTitle element.
 <xsd:element name="ChartLegendTitle" type="ChartLegendTitleType" minOccurs="0" />
